title: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be
called the Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act,
1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Definitions

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
2. Definitions.‑‑In
this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context:‑‑
(a) "Board" means the
Board of Trustees of the Institute:
(b) "Governing Body"
means the Governing Body of the Institute:
(c) "Chancellor"
means the Chancellor of the Institute;
(d) "Dean" means the
Dean of a school, faculty or other teaching or research Department or unit of
the Institute:
(e) "Institute" means
the Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology:
(f) "Prescribed"
means prescribed by rules or regulations:
(g) "President" means
the President of the Institute;
(h) "Regulations"
means regulations framed under this Act;
(i) "Rules" means rules
framed under this Act;
(j) "Society" means
the Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Society of Science and Technology;
(k) "Teachers" means
the Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors, Lecturers and
Research Staff engaged by the Institute, or such other persons as may be
recognized by the Governing Body:
(I) "Vice‑President"
means a Vice‑President of the Institute:

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Establishment of incorporation of the institute

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
3. Establishment and incorporation of the Institute.‑‑(1) The
Institute registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 under
Registration No.2225 is reconstituted and re‑established at Karachi as an
Institute to be called the Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and
Technology, consisting of‑‑
(a) the members of the Board,
the Committee and such other bodies as the Board may establish;
(b) the Chancellor, the
President, the Vice‑President, and Deans and other members of the
Governing Body;
(c) the teachers and students
of the Institute and its constituent units; and
(d) such other officers and
members of the staff as may from time to time specified by the Board.
(2) The Institute shall be a
body. corporate by the name of Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science
and Technology having perpetual succession and a common seal, with powers,
among others, to acquire, hold, control and dispose of movable and immovable
properties and shall by the said name sue and be sued.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Power and functions of the institute

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
4. Powers and functions of the Institute.‑‑The Institute
shall have powers‑‑
(a) to provide for instruction
and training in basic sciences, applied sciences, technology and other allied
disciplines in such manner as it considers appropriate so as to produce
competent, imaginative, skilled and committed scientists, engineers and
researchers;
(b) to print, publish and
circulate periodicals, journals, magazines and books and disseminate
scientific, technological and other related knowledge and information conducive
to the attainment of any of the objectives of the Institute;
(c) to promote, contact and
establish liaison with national and international Universities, institutions
and other research and development organizations within the country and abroad
for effective discharge of its functions and responsibilities;
(d) to provide assistance to
industry, Government institutions and organizations in the country and abroad
through expert advice, consultations and in any other manner as it may deem
fit;
(e) to undertake joint
investigations and collaborative research in the field of basic sciences,
Technology and other allied disciplines;
(f) to pursue and make provisions
for research, innovations, inventions, demonstrations and other services as it
may deem fit;
(g) to admit and examine
students;
(h) to hold examinations and to
confer or award degrees, diplomas, certificates, academic and research prizes
and distinctions on and to persons who fulfil the requirements or have passed
its examinations in accordance with the conditions laid down in the rules and
regulations;
(x) to use its financial and
other resources to the fullest extent for the execution of its programmes;
(y) to enter into‑
agreements, contracts and arrangements with organizations, institutions, bodies
and individuals for carrying out its functions and activities;
(z) to define selection,
admission and examine students in affiliated institutions;
(aa) to hold examinations and
confer or award degrees, diplomas, certificates and other academic distinctions
on the persons, who have passed such examinations under the prescribed
conditions approved by the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council, Pakistan Nursing
Council or by the Chancellor as the case may be;
(ab) to receive and manage
property, grants, bequests, trusts, gifts, donations, endowments and other
contributions made to the Institute and obtain loan or aid and to invest them
in such manner as it may deem fit; and
(ac) to do all such other acts
and things as may be required to further its objectives and perform its
functions.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Institute open to all

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
5. . Institute open to all.‑‑The Institute shall be open to
persons of either sex of whatever religion, race, creed, colour or domicile who
are academically qualified for admission to the courses of study offered by the
Institute, and no such person shall be denied the Privileges of the Institute
only on grounds of sex, religion, creed, race, class, colour or domicile.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Officers of the institute

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
6. Officers of the Institute.‑‑The following shall be the
officers of the Institute namely:‑‑
(a) the Chancellor;
(b) the President;
(c) the Vice‑Presidents;
(d) the Deans; and
(e) such other persons as may
be specified by the rules or regulations to be officers of the Institute.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
The chancellor

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
7. The Chancellor.‑‑(1) The Chairman of the Board shall be
the Chancellor of the Institute.
(2) The Chancellor shall, when
present, preside over the convocations of the Institute and, in his absence, a
person nominated by him shall preside.
(3) Every proposal to confer an
honorary degree shall be subject to confirmation by the Chancellor.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Visitation

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
8. Visitation.‑‑(1) The Chancellor may cause an inspection
or inquiry to be made in respect of any matter connected with the affairs of
the Institute and may, when considered necessary, direct one or more persons or
any organization to carry out inspection or inquiry of‑‑
(a) the Institute, its
buildings, laboratories, libraries and other facilities;
(b) any institution, school,
centre, division or hostel maintained by the Institute;
(c) the adequacy of human and
financial resources;
(d) the teachings, research,
curriculum, examinations and other matters of the Institute; and
(e) such other matters as may
be specified by the Chancellor.
(2) The Chancellor shall, in
every case as aforesaid, give notice to the Governing Body of his intention to
cause an inspection or inquiry to be made, and the Governing Body shall be
entitled to be represented thereat.
(3) The Chancellor shall
communicate to the Governing Body his views with regard to the results of an
inspection or inquiry and shall after considering the explanation or
representation, if any, made by the Governing Body, advise the Governing Body
to take such actions or refrain from doing such things as he may specify in
this behalf.
(4) The Governing Body shall,
within such time as may be specified by the Chancellor, report to him such
actions, if any, as has been taken or may be proposed to be taken upon the
results of an inspection or inquiry.
(5) Where the Governing Body
does not, within the time specified, take action to the satisfaction of the
Chancellor, the Chancellor may issue such directions as may be considered
appropriate and the Governing Body shall comply with all such directions.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
The president

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
9. The President.‑‑(1) The President and a Vice‑President
shall be appointed by the Chancellor in consultation with the Governing Body
for a fixed period on such terms and conditions as the Chancellor may
determine.
(2) The President shall
exercise general control and supervision over the affairs of the Institute and
shall ensure that the provisions of this Act, the regulations, the rules,
policies and directions of the Governing Body are properly executed.
(3) The President shall perform
such other functions as may be entrusted to him by the Chancellor or the
Governing Body.
(4) ,The President shall also
have power‑‑
(a) to supervise the activities
connected with the execution of programmes for teachings, training, research,
inventions, innovations, demonstrations and other services;
(b) to incur or authorize
expenditure provided for in the budget in accordance with the rules;
(c) to appoint, with the
approval of the Governing Body, teacher and officers of the Institute and such
other persons as may be necessary in accordance with Rules so as to ensure the
highest intellectual and moral qualities in the persons appointed;
(d) to re‑appropriate
funds within the approved budget;
(e) to sanction by re‑appropriation
an amount not exceeding a sum specified in the rules and regulations or an
unforeseen time not provided for in the budget, and report it to the Governing
Body;
(f) to engage experts and
consultants as may be required for efficient and effective discharge of he
functions of the Institute;
(g) to constitute from amongst
the officers and staff of the Institute such, Committees, Sub‑Committees
and Working Groups as he may deem necessary;
(h) to perform such other
functions and exercise such other powers as may be entrusted or delegated to
him by the Governing Body from time to time; and
(i) to delegate any of his
powers to appropriate levels of management subject to such conditions as he may
deem fit to impose

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
The vice-president development

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
10.‑ The Vice‑President Administration and Finance.‑‑(1) Subject
to the over all supervision of the President, the Vice‑Presidents
Administration and Finance shall be incharge of the Administration and Finances
of the Institute and shall formulate and recommend to the Governing Body for
approval, rules and regulations relating to administrative and financial
matters of the Institute.
(2) For proper control of financial
matters, the Vice‑President will be assisted by the Director of Finance.
(3) The Vice‑President
Administration and Finance shall have the power‑‑
(a) to liaise with Government
agencies, local bodies and other authorities in connection with the administrative
affairs of the Institute;
(b) to administer the
residences of the students, teachers and other staff members of the Institute;
(c) to supervise the extra‑curricular
and recreational activities of the Institute, including the matters of health and
general welfare;
(d) to maintain discipline in
the Institute:
(e) to appoint staff members of
the Institute against vacant posts in accordance with the rules and
regulations;
(f) to engage such casual,
workers, subject to budgetary provisions, as may be required from time to time;
(g) to initiate disciplinary
action against the employees of the Institute and impose penalties, including
suspension, removal or dismissal from service, in accordance with the rules and
regulations;
(h) to administer the financial
resources of the institute;
(i) to sanction expenditure
provided for in the approved budget in accordance with the Rules;
(j) to perform such other
functions and exercise such other powers as may be entrusted or delegated to
him by the governing Body, of the President; and
(k) to delegate any of his
powers to appropriate levels of management, subject to such conditions as he
may deem fit to impose;
(1) to provide for the teaching
of specified courses and training for persons not being the students of the
Institute and grant certificates and diplomas to such persons;
(j) to recognize the
examination passed or the period of study spent at other Universities or places
of learning as equivalent to examinations or periods of study in the Institute or
withdraw such recognition;
(k) to create posts for
teaching, research, extension, administration, training and for any other
purposes related thereto and appoint persons thereto;
(1) to inspect schools,
colleges, Universities and other institutions of learning associated or seeking
association with it;
(m) to institute and award
fellowships, scholarships. stipends, bursaries, medals and prizes;
(n) to establish, administer
and maintain halls of residence and approve my place as hostel or lodging for students;
(o) to supervise and control
the discipline of the students of the Institute, and promote extra‑curricular
and recreational activities of such students, and to make arrangements for
promoting their health and general welfare;
(p) to charge and receive such
fees and other payments as it may determine;
(q) to authorize and agree to
the mobility of qualified staff among Universities, research and development
organizations and the Government or corporate bodies on terms and conditions
laid down in the rules or regulations;
(r) to select and promote
faculties:
(s) to confer honorary degrees
(t) to prescribe courses of
studies in basic sciences, applied, sciences, technology and other allied
disciplines,
(u) to establish workshop,
laboratories, museums and other facilities for training, education and
research;
(v) to affiliate or associate
itself with other Institutions and to establish faculties in Pakistan or abroad
for the effective discharge of its functions and responsibilities;
(w) to decide teaching methods
and strategies in order to ensure the most effective educational and training
programmes;

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
The vice-president academic

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
11. The Vice‑President Development.‑‑(1) Subject to
the overall supervisions of the President the Vice‑President Development
shall be incharge of the developments affairs of the Institute and shall
formulate and recommend to the Governing Body for approval rules and
regulations relating to developmental matters of the institute;
(2) The Vice‑President
Development shall have the power‑‑
(a) to administer the planning
and developmental activity of the Institute;
(b) to advise the Governing
Body on all matters relating to planning and development of the Institute
buildings, laboratories, workshops, library, halls of residence and staff
houses;
(c) to perform such other
functions exercise such other powers as may be entrusted or delegated to him by
the Governing Body, or the President; and
(d) delegate any of his powers
to appropriate levels of management, subject to such conditions as he may deem
fit to impose.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
The vice-president administration and finance

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
12. The Vice‑President Academic.‑‑(1) The Vice‑President
Academic shall be in charge of the academic affairs of the Institute and shall
assist the President on matters relating to teaching, research, academic
programmes, extension and other development projects.
(2) Subject to the overall
supervisions of the President, the Vice -President shall formulate and
recommend to the Governing Body for approval, rules and regulations relating to
academic and research matters of the Institute.
(3) The Vice‑President
Academic shall have power‑‑
(a) to liaise with
Universities, learning institutions, industry and other research organizations
for apprenticeship and placement of students, training of teachers, and other
academic and research activities;
(b) to submit recommendations
to the Governing Body on the courses of study to be taught in the Institute
giving due consideration to the advice of the Board and other bodies constituted
for this purpose;
(c) to supervise the admission
of students to the courses of studies and examinations of the Institute;
(d) to coordinate the award of
fellowships, stipends, medals and prizes;
(e) to arrange convocations;
(f) to make such arrangements
for the scrutiny of papers and results as he may consider necessary;
(g) to coordinate the teaching
and research woke of the schools or faculties of the Institute;
(h) to control and manage the
publications and circulation of periodicals, magazines, journals and books and
dissemination of scientific, technological and other related information;
(i) to perform such other
functions and exercise such other powers as may be entrusted or delegated to
him by the Governing Body or the President; and
(j) to delegate any of his
powers to appropriate levels of management, subject to such conditions as he
may dem fit to impose.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Dean

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
13 . Dean.‑‑(1)
Each Dean shall be appointed by the Governing Body for a fixed period which may
be extended by it.
(2) Subject to the overall
supervision of the President, each Dean shall have power‑‑
(a) to ensure proper
implementation of the rules and regulations relating to his school or faculty;
(b) to regulate the conduct and
discipline of the students of his school or faculty and impose penalties
including cancellation of the enrolment of the students:
(c) to coordinate, advise and
liaise with Board Vice‑President Academic, other academic authorities and
Vice‑President Administration and Vice‑President Finance for
teaching, research, extension, development works and administrative matters;
(d) to present candidates for
admission to degrees, except honorary degrees, in the course falling within the
purview of his school or faculty;
(e) to appoint examiners for
all the examinations of his respective school or faculty;
(f) to direct teachers,
students and staff members. of his school or faculty to take up such
assignments in connection with teaching and research as he may consider
appropriate;
(g) to nominate teachers,
students and staff members of his school or faculty for training, fellowships,
scholarships and other academic distinctions; and
(h) to perform such other
duties and exercise such other powers as may be assigned to, or vested in him
by the Governing Body or the Presidents.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
The board

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
14. The Board.‑‑(1) The overall control of the Institute
shall vest in the Board.
(2) Changes in the composition
of the Board can be made by the Board itself.
(3) In particular and without
prejudice to the generality of the foregoing provisions, the Board shall have
the powers‑‑
(a) to approve the creation of
new components of the Institute such as school, faculty or any other teaching
or research unit;
(b) to approve changes in the
constitution of the Governing Body of the Institute;
(c) to perform all such other
activities as may be required for the furtherance of the objectives of the
Institute; and
(d) to delegate any of its
powers to the Governing Body, the President or other appropriate levels of
management subject to such conditions as it may deem fit to impose;
(e) to exercise total financial
control.
(4) The Secretary of the
Society shall act as Secretary of the Board and the Committee constituted under
this Act and shall perform such duties and exercise such power as may be
entrusted or delegated to him by the Board or the Committee:

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
The governing body

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
15. The Governing Body.‑‑(1) Without prejudice to the
generality of the control of the Board, the general supervision and control of
the Institute shall vest in the Governing Body which shall subject to re‑constitution
and expansion from time to time, consist of the following members namely:
Nominated Members;
(a) the President;
(b) two eminent engineers;
(c) two prominent scientists;
(d) three distinguished persons
known for their learning or experience in the field of banking. Finance,
industry or any other field of interest;
(e) three prominent citizens to
be nominated by the Chancellor;
(f) four members of the Board
nominated by the Chancellor.
Ex‑Officio Members:
(g) Vice‑President;
(h) Chairman, University Grants
Commission;
(i) Vice‑Chancellor, NED
University of Engineering and Technology, Karachi;
(j) Secretary Education,
Government of Sindh:
(2) The nominated members of
the Governing Body shall be nominated by the Board.
(3) A nominated member of the
Governing Body shall, unless the Board terminates his membership earlier, hold
office for a term of three years and shall be eligible for renomination on the
expiry of his term:
Provided that the first
Governing Body to be constituted after the commencement of this Act shall be
appointed by the Chancellor.
(4) The office of a nominated
member of the Governing Body shall become vacant if he resigns or fails to
attend three consecutive meetings of the Governing Body without sufficient or
leave of absence.
(5) A casual vacancy in the
office of a member of the Governing Body shall be filled by a person nominated
by the Governing Body and approved by the Chancellor;
(6) No act or proceedings of
the Governing Body shall be invalid by reason only of the existence of a
vacancy in or any defect in the constitution of, the Governing Body.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Powers and functions of the governing body

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
16. Powers and functions of the Governing Body.‑‑The Governing Body
shall exercise and perform the following powers and functions, namely:---
(a) to hold, control and
administer the property, funds and resources of the Institute and borrow or
raise money for the purpose of the Institute upon such securities as may be
required;
(b) to acquire or dispose of
any movable or immovable property of the Institute;
(c) to recommend creation of
the new components of the Institute such as school department, faculty ,
division or any other teaching or research unit for approval to the Board;
(d) to formulate or approve
long‑term strategy, policies and plans governing the activities and
operation of the Institute so as to ensure its autonomy in teaching, research
and other academic work;
(e) to approve plans of work
and the annual budget of the institute;
(f) to call for annual, bi‑annual
or quarterly progress reports relating to the activities of the Institute and
execution of the approved work plans to review the progress and direct the Vice‑President
concerned to furnish information relating to any matter specified by the
Governing Body;
(g) to create such
administrative or academic posts on specified terms and conditions as it may
deem necessary and to approve appointment to the posts of Vice‑President,
Deans and Professors on the recommendation of a duly constituted Selection
Committee;
(h) to ensure financial
viability of the Institute and effectiveness of the operations, their
continuity and preservation of the autonomy of the institute;
(i) to approve all affiliations
and other arrangements through which University and other research and
development organizations may become associated with the Institute;
(j) to appoint from amongst its
members such committees or sub committees as it may deem necessary;
(k) to take all such initiative
as it consider necessary or desirable for the efficient and effective
management and functioning of the Institute;
(1) to approve the rules of the
Institute, and
(m) to delegate any of its
powers to the President, the Vice‑Presidents and other appropriate levels
of management in the Institute subject to such conditions as it may deem fit to
impose.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Meeting of the governing body

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
17. Meeting of the Governing Body.‑‑(1) The Governing Body
shall meet at least twice a year on dates to be fixed by the President:
Provided that special meeting may
be called at any time at the request of not less than five members of the
Governing Body, to consider any matter of an urgent nature.
(2) The President shall, when
present, preside over the meetings of the Governing Body and in his absence a
member nominated by him shall preside.
(3) The quorum for a meeting of
the Governing Body shall be one half of its members, a fraction being counted
as one out of which not less than four shall be the nominated members.
case of equality of votes, the President shall have
and exercise casting vote.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
The academic council

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
18. The Academic Council.‑‑(1) The Academic Council, shall
consist of‑‑
(i) The President (Chairman);
(ii) All the Vice‑Presidents;
(iii) All the Deans;
(iv) All the Heads of the
Departments;
(v) All Professors and
Associate Professors of the Institute;
(vi) Nominee of the Education
Secretary of Government not below the rank of Deputy Secretary, the Regional
Director of Education (Colleges) and the Director of Technical Education of the
Division in which the Institute is located;
(vii) One Assistant Professor
and one Lecturer to be nominated by the Governing Body;
(vii) Three persons eminent in
the arts, the sciences and the professions of whom one shall be from each
category to be nominated by the Governing Body;
(ix) Director Academics,
University Grants Commission;
(x) The Secretary of the Board
shall act as Member/Secretary.
(2) Members appointed by
nomination shall hold office for three years.
(3) The quorum for a meeting of
the Academic Council shall be one‑ third of the total number of members,
a fraction being counted as one.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Powers and duties of the academic council

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
19. Powers and duties of the Academic Council.‑‑(1) The
Academic Council shall be the academic body of the Institute and shall, subject
to the provisions of this Act and the rules and regulations have the powers to
lay down proper standards of instructions research publication and examination
and to regulate and promote the academic life of the Institute.
(2) Without prejudice to the
generality of the foregoing powers and subject to the provision of this Act and
the rules and regulation, the Academic Council shall have the powers‑‑
(a) to advise the Governing
Body on academic matters;
(b) to regulate the conduct of
teaching research, publication and examination;
(c) to regulate the admission
of students to the courses of studies and examination in the Institute;
(d) to regulate the conduct and
discipline of the students of the Institute;
(e) to propose to the Governing
Body, scheme for the constitution and organization of Faculties and Teaching
Departments;
(f) to consider or formulate
proposals for the planning and development of teaching and research in the
Institute;
(g) to make regulations
prescribing the course of studies; the syllabi and the outlines of tests for
all Institute examinations subject to the approval of the Governing Body;
(h) to regulate the award of
studentships, scholarship., exhibitions, medals and prizes;
(i) to frame regulations for
submission to the Governing Body;
(j) to appoint/nominate members
to the various Authorities in accordance with the provisions of this Act, and
(k) to perform such other
functions as may be prescribed by Governing Body.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Academic and administrative staff

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
20. Academic and Administrative Staff.‑‑The
Academic and Administrative Staff of the Institute shall be selected with a
view to achieving its stated objectives and the basic criteria for their
selection shall be the highest standard of competence, integrity and
efficiency.

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Fund audit and account of the institute

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
21. Fund Audit and Accounts of the Institute.‑‑(1) The
Institute shall have a FUND to which shall be credited‑‑‑
(a) all grants and
contributions made by the Society;
(b) donations, contributions,
subscriptions, aid and grants made by the donors and benefactors;
(c) aid, grants and other forms
of assistance by any foreign Government, Federal Government, Provincial
Government and Local Bodies, national and international institutions,
organizations and agencies; and '
(d) fees, remuneration, charges
for any service rendered, sale proceeds, royalties on publications, commission
and receipts from any other source:
(2) The accounts of the
Institute shall be maintained in such form and in such manner as may be
specified by the Governing Body.
(3) The accounts of the
Institute shall be audited each year by an Auditor to be appointed by the
Governing Body.

Indemnity and bar of jurisdiction

ACT XI OF 1995

SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
22. Indemnity and bar of Jurisdiction.‑‑(1) No suit,
prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie against any person or
authority for anything which is done in good faith or intended to be done under
this Act.
(2) No decision taken, or act
or thing done, by the Chancellor or the Board or Governing Body under this Act
shall be called in question before any Court of law or any other authority. .

sections.shortTitle: Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act 1995
sections.description:
Removal of difficulties

ACT XI OF 1995
ACT XI OF 1995
SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO
INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995
24. Removal of difficulties.‑(1) If any question arises as to the
interpretation of any of the provisions of this Act, it shall be placed before
the Chancellor whose decision thereon shall be final.
(2) If any difficulty arises in
giving effect to any of the provisions of this Act, the Chancellor may make
such order not inconsistent with the provisions of this Act as may appear to be
necessary for removing the difficulty in question.
(3) Where this Act makes any
provision for anything to be done, but no provision or insufficient provision
has been made as respecting the authority by whom, or the time at which, or
manner in which it shall be done then it shall be done by such authority or at
such time, or in such manner, as the Chancellor may direct.
